collection.description: The pre-built collection of instances used by the grid. This must be specified when the component is created.

readOnly.description: If true, suppress editing of the content, even if the collection allows it.

onePage.description: If true, suppress pagination of the collection, even if it appears to have multiple pages.

hideEmptyCols.description:
If true, hide columns whose content is empty. This means that the columns could change when moving from page to
page, but works well with collections of uniform models or when there is only a single page.

title:
This component manages a grid presentation of a collection of Obj instances.

@see UiCollection
name: CollectionGrid
